def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Calculate direction to enemy using atan2 built-in
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    angle_to_enemy = atan2(dy, dx)  # Returns radians
    angle_to_enemy_deg = degrees(angle_to_enemy)
    angle_diff = angle_to_enemy_deg - me.heading
    # Normalize to -180..180
    angle_diff = (angle_diff + 180) % 360 - 180
    
    # If not facing enemy, turn toward them
    if abs(angle_diff) > 5:
        if angle_diff > 0:
            return (-1, 1)  # Turn left
        else:
            return (1, -1)  # Turn right
    
    # Facing enemy, move forward
    return (1, 1)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # Check if opponent is in a vulnerable state
    vulnerable = (enemy.on_side or enemy.airborne or enemy.z < 0.1 or 
                  not enemy.can_drive or enemy.held or enemy.lifted)
    
    # If we have a flipper and opponent is vulnerable, try to flip
    if 'flipper' in me.weapons:
        flipper = me.weapons['flipper']
        if (flipper.get('shots_left', 0) > 0 and 
            flipper.get('ready', False) and 
            enemy.z < 0.5 and

    dy = enemy.y - me.y
